mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roomboards ( members_username, title, detail, address, postcode, price, house_size, price_per, rent_start, rent_until, hashtags, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{dto.membersUsername}, #{dto.title}, #{dto.detail}, #{dto.address}, #{dto.postcode}, #{dto.price}, #{dto.houseSize}, #{dto.pricePer}, #{dto.rentStart}, #{dto.rentUntil}, #{dto.hashtags, typeHandler=com.aladin.common.JsonTypeHandler}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT rb.id AS id, rb.members_username AS members_username, rb.title AS title, rb.detail AS detail, rb.address AS address, rb.postcode AS postcode, rb.price AS price, rb.house_size AS house_size, rb.price_per AS price_per, rb.rent_start AS rent_start, rb.rent_until AS rent_until, rb.hashtags AS hashtags, rb.views AS views, rb.created_at AS created_at, rb.updated_at AS updated_at, rbi.url AS thumbnail_url, m.profile_image_path AS profileImagePath, m.nickname AS nickname FROM roomboards rb LEFT JOIN roomboards_images rbi ON rb.id = rbi.roomboards_id AND rbi.image_order = 0 LEFT JOIN members m ON rb.members_username = m.username ORDER BY rb.id DESC;

SELECT rb.id, rb.members_username, rb.title, rb.detail, rb.address, rb.postcode, rb.price, rb.house_size, rb.price_per, rb.rent_start, rb.rent_until, rb.hashtags, rb.views, rb.created_at, rb.updated_at, m.nickname, m.profile_image_path FROM roomboards rb LEFT JOIN members m ON rb.members_username = m.username WHERE rb.id = #{roomboardsId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roomboards_images (roomboards_id, url, image_order) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageOrder});
mapper.update: UPDATE roomboards SET title = #{dto.title}, detail = #{dto.detail}, address = #{dto.address}, postcode = #{dto.postcode}, price = #{dto.price}, house_size = #{dto.houseSize}, price_per = #{dto.pricePer}, rent_start = #{dto.rentStart}, rent_until = #{dto.rentUntil}, hashtags = #{dto.hashtags, typeHandler=com.aladin.common.JsonTypeHandler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{dto.id};
